about: module tn1's mutants (wf10 TS1): edits of the TN1 engine that the conformance vectors (VectorsAreReproduced) or the law PermilleRises must notice; judged by scripts/examples -modules tn1.

mutants.name: ts1-out-scale-dropped
mutants.rule: A hidden unit adds OutScale times its out trit times its excess over its bias.

mutants.name: ts1-window-offset
mutants.rule: A hidden unit reads the lines i-1, i, i+1 and i+2.

mutants.name: ts1-conv-bias-strict
mutants.rule: A conv window fires when its sum is at least the filter's bias.

mutants.name: ts1-no-lowering
mutants.rule: The filters read the comment with A to Z lowered.

mutants.name: ts1-low-clamp
mutants.rule: A score under -8 has the probability of -8 (law PermilleRises reaches it).

mutants.name: ts1-pack-minus
mutants.rule: A packed -1 trit is the base-3 digit 2, so the model id names the weights.

mutants.name: ts2-substitution-not-closed
mutants.from:
stack = stack[:depth-1]
			let p = templateEnd(src, i+1)
mutants.rule: A } that closes a template's ${ resumes the template and closes the substitution.

mutants.name: ts2-no-regex
mutants.rule: A slash where an expression starts opens a regular expression, whose } and / are not code.

mutants.name: ts2-ternary-ends
mutants.rule: A line that starts with ? or : continues the statement before it.

mutants.name: ts2-label-not-skipped
mutants.rule: A labelled loop is a block statement: it ends at its closing brace.

mutants.name: ts2-imported-names-kept
mutants.rule: A name an import binds is not a code word wherever it is used.

mutants.name: ts2-no-handler-start
mutants.rule: A catch, or a call of catchX, starts a handler on its line.
